<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Страница-1" id="7iwivJVaxXX_xAsHsXln"> <mxGraphModel dx="1943" dy="1242" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "stateDiagram-v2
 direction LR

 state \"Card.status (CardStatus.java)\" as CardSt {
 [*] --> ACTIVE: createCard
 ACTIVE --> INACTIVE: patchCard / bulkUpdateStatus
 INACTIVE --> ACTIVE: patchCard / bulkUpdateStatus
 ACTIVE --> BLOCKED: patchCard / bulkUpdateStatus
 BLOCKED --> ACTIVE: patchCard / bulkUpdateStatus
 ACTIVE --> EXPIRED: expiryDate раньше даты транзакции (вычисляется в authorize, в БД не пишется)
 ACTIVE --> DELETED: deleteCard (мягкое)
 DELETED --> [*]
 }
 note right of CardSt
 patchCard не проверяет допустимость переходов:
 status просто подставляется.
 Authorize одобряет только ACTIVE:
 BLOCKED - CARD_BLOCKED, INACTIVE - CARD_INACTIVE,
 EXPIRED - CARD_EXPIRED (код 54).
 end note

 state \"Transaction (жизненный цикл)\" as TxSt {
 [*] --> RECEIVED: POST /api/transactions
 RECEIVED --> APPROVED: Authorization APPROVED, резерв создан
 RECEIVED --> DECLINED: unknown BIN, Authorization DECLINED или недоступна
 APPROVED --> ROLLED_BACK: reversal — публикация в Logger не удалась, клиенту 96
 APPROVED --> LOGGED_A: записано в Logger
 DECLINED --> LOGGED_D: записано в Logger
 LOGGED_A --> [*]
 LOGGED_D --> [*]
 ROLLED_BACK --> [*]
 }
 note right of TxSt
 В коде TransactionStatus = APPROVED или DECLINED.
 ROLLED_BACK - это ReservationStatus в Card-Management:
 RESERVED - ROLLED_BACK, повторный rollback - ALREADY_ROLLED_BACK (409).
 Откатанная транзакция в Logger не сохраняется.
 end note",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
